review.verdict_scope: Independent static SSI-CANONICAL-v10 contract validation only; no run, observation, scientific result, hypothesis transition, official state transition, or execution authorization.
blocking_residuals: Snapshot receipt is path-hash-bound but not self-bound to a commit_sha.
Registry frame and several embedded/domain digest preimages are not fully specified; HELPER-SLOT and fixed index records do not fit the universal object grammar as written.
Terminal stream_digest and terminal_digest are mutually circular.
Advice generator/source interpretation and pre-target witness are not materialized; SSI-PAIR-MATRIX-v5 is named but undefined.
Finite attempt seed list is request-bound, but pair encoding, uniqueness/weighting, and uniformity semantics are incomplete.
Numeric event primitive charges exist, but exact branch event populations, operation-count equations, and trace-header grammar are not complete.
Memory lifetime tuples are declared, but allocation/release identity is not represented in EVENT-v5 or a complete table grammar.
Provider trust is intentionally null; artifact/mirror/transition-root preimages and the trust-key relation still need closure.
HNF normalization, saturation, aggregate operation-log, scalar, and witness semantics remain incomplete.
PAIR-REQUEST/TRACE-SHARED/FINAL-IDENTITY and null mutation grammars are absent, with a domain_code(1) versus domain-4 ambiguity.
C-pair and synthetic controls are design manifests with no measured rows/cells or independent receipts and therefore remain INVALID_CONTROL.
The incumbent has null FOE/memory/source values and correctly blocks comparison, break-even, and freeze.
No backend was selected or probed and the native session model label is unverified; no execution or scientific evidence is present.
